Market today:
The mood is bullish, driven by strong AI demand, especially in chips, and general market optimism from big banks. This is great news for your tech-heavy book.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-44.89%) and SPAL (-44.45%) are both leveraged ETFs showing significant losses and are flagged for attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH is also down (-8.44%) but is not leveraged.

Watch:
Keep an eye on the broader chip sector's reaction to the TSMC news. Also, monitor any geopolitical developments that could introduce volatility.

Bottom line:
Focus on managing risk in your leveraged positions while staying alert for opportunities in the strong chip sector.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL and SPAL given their deep losses and leveraged nature; consider trimming or tightening stops to protect capital.
Consider ALAB for a new long position, given its strong scanner setup (entry 331-330.27, stop 328.6) and alignment with the buoyant chip/AI theme.
Watch SMH closely; the scanner shows a long setup (entry 579.6-579.02, stop 576.24) which could be a good add if the chip rally continues.
